aboutPage.title: About us
aboutPage.lead: We sell boat parts that are meant to fit, seal and last – and we help you choose the right one.
aboutPage.story: Davids boat parts is a small shop for people who actually go out on the water. The range is deliberately tight: anchors, propellers, ropes, navigation lights, pumps and a bit of electronics. Better to have the right part in stock than shelves of things nobody asks for.
aboutPage.help: Unsure about size, pitch or what fits your boat? Ask the chat in the bottom right. It knows our catalogue and does not guess.
